reads.note: RSS Feed Read v1.1 GET of each feed URL Set Tech News RSS Feeds lists (seven, one item per URL after Split Out); Filter keeps items whose isoDate is after $now minus one day

branches: Filter: items older than one day dropped
Text Classifier: AI articles kept, others discarded (fallback discard)
expect.offline: Only the Get Articles Daily branch runs from this trigger (the template has three more schedule triggers for later steps, each starting from a MongoDB query). The articles' dates are relative to the run's $now (Filter compares with $now minus one day), so the fixture's `now` must be the run clock for the window to hold. MongoDB inserts cannot be answered offline
expect.n8nCannotRun: MongoDB, the main path's last step, has no bench sidecar (only postgres and mysql are seeded), so n8n's MongoDB node cannot connect
